description:
The living together of women with sweet and brutal secrets at the shared housing begins! An agent with the codename “The invisible”, who killed the director of the Security Intelligence Service sneaks into the shared housing for youngsters at the hillside edge of Itaewon! 3 years ago, former elite agent Jian Choi loses her crush/colleague by making a mistake in midst of the execution of the operation to catch “the invisible”, and now she’s living her life as unemployed. Although no one believes in me, I will reveal the invisible man’s true self and go back to the Security Intelligence Service…! But her life goes tough. At the shared housing, Jian faces youngsters with many different lifestyles! Will Jian succeed in catching “the invisible” this time?!
